rows.text: calls `00599770(rdx)` and copies `0x54` bytes from the returned pointer to `r8` (five 16-byte `movups` blocks at `+0` through `+0x40`, then dword `+0x50`), returning that last dword in `eax`

on the two-qword link pair at `rdx+8` (next at `+0`, previous at `+8`), stores the previous pointer at `+8` of the next node and the next pointer at `+0` of the previous node, then points both of the pair's own qwords at `rdx+8` itself

copies dword `rdx+0x10` to `rcx+0x10` and returns `rcx` at once when it is zero; otherwise calls `0067B100(rcx, dword [rdx] with bit 31 cleared)` and then, when qword `rcx+8` is non-null, `00861EBA(qword rcx+8, qword rdx+8, dword rcx+0x10)`, and returns `rcx`
returns 0 in `al` when byte `rcx+0x48` is zero; otherwise calls `005CD840(rcx+0x28)` and `005CD5E0(rcx+0x28)` and returns 1

notes: 0067ADD0: the `cmovne` re-tests dword `rdx+0x10`, which is already known non-zero on that path, so the third argument to 00861EBA is always qword `rdx+8` there; the row says so directly. 0067ADD0 reads `0067B100`'s effect on `rcx+8`/`rcx+0x10` only after the call (re-loads both), so the size passed is the post-call dword.
